You'll bring core consulting skills, financial services industry knowledge, and the ability to work with key stakeholders (product managers, technical / engineering teams, and Market Makers) to qualify product fit, pitch / demo products to clients, shape \& commercialize opportunities, and deliver work by managing scope, timeline, and client outcomes.  Strong Bonus Points

* Degraded scan restoration.

* Experience developing proprietary OCR or document\-understanding models.

 Who Thrives Here

 The objective is a document intelligence platform that becomes more accurate, resilient, efficient, and specialized as it processes more of the records we work with.
